appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Weeks with Promotional Campaigns: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Sales ($ thousands)' and has tick marks from 0 to 200 in increments of 20.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' and has tick marks from 0 to 60 in increments of 10.
There are six blue circular data points, each labeled with a week number (Week 2 through Week 6).
The data points are arranged in a generally increasing trend from left to right and bottom to top.
The data point for 'Week 2' is the lowest on the chart, positioned near the origin at approximately (20, 65).
The data point for 'Week 6' is the highest on the chart, positioned at approximately (60, 190).
All data points are blue circles of the same size and color.

public_definitions: The user must review the promotional campaign dashboard and choose one of three spend decision options.
The dashboard chart shows a positive correlation between advertising spend and sales over six weeks.
The options for the spend decision are: 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader spend expansion', or 'Maintain current budget with no change'.
